thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden 5xx + token latency spike on /v1/chat with tool_calls enabled. Current error rate 8% (baseline 0.2%). Auto-signal: page eng-oncall.
Maria: seeing huge queue buildup on gpu-pool-a, KV cache warms failing, many requests hang waiting for tool invocation slots.
Kevin: confirmed. Spike started ~5m ago after a customer ramp. Replica CPU <90% but GPU queue length skyrocketed.
Samir: logs show downstream tool proxy timing out at 10s and client retries piling up. We need a quick mitigation to reduce tail latency.
Jessica: oncall-handoff imminent in 10m (I have to jump to another pager). Tagging Kevin to own actions now, Samir to assist for root cause.
Kevin: taking lead. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) soft-lock non-critical tool/function calls (reduce concurrency) 2) strip structured output by default for long responses 3) apply per-tenant burst limits.
Tia: Customer Support - which customers are impacted? We're getting messages from two mid-market tenants complaining about slow chat replies.
Maria: impacted tenants list: ledger-app (mid), teachly (small), one enterprise partner in eu-west. High error rate correlates with ledger-app traffic spike.
Kevin: I will push a temporary routing rule to slow tool calls for all non-enterprise tenants. Command I'm about to run: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/runtime/mitigate -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"action":"soft_lock_tool_calls","scope":"non_enterprise","max_concurrency":1,"reason":"live overload 1977777777"}'
```
Samir: suggest also toggling structured output mode to "plaintext-fallback" for requests > 512 tokens to avoid heavy JSON serialization.
Kevin: applying plaintext fallback for >512 token responses on hosted routes now. ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/runtime/config -d '{"key":"structured_output_mode","value":"plaintext_on_long"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN"```
DeployBot: deploy queued: mitigation-rule-service v2.14 -> canary -> prod. Canary started.
Jessica: I pushed a monitor on error-rate for ledger-app specifically. Watching dashboards.
Maria: metric update: overall 5xx dropped from 8% -> 3.5% after the soft-lock but latency p95 still elevated.
Kevin: fine. Next step: reduce per-tenant burst window from 60s -> 20s for tenants with >500 rps. Command: ```bash
# set quota window
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/quotas -d '{"scope":"burst","threshold_rps":500,"window_s":20}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN"
```
Tia: CS notified ledger-app of degraded experience and rollback plan. They asked for ETA.
Samir: digging into tool proxy logs — a particular external tool (vector-search) is timing out under high concurrency. Suggest blackholed retry to that tool and degrade the model path to local embeddings temporarily.
Kevin: blackhole vector-search for non-critical tenants now and add fallback to local-kv. ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/runtime/blackhole -d '{"target":"vector-search","scope":"non_enterprise"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN"
```
IncidentBot: NOTE: change requests applied by Kevin at 1977777895, 1977777920, 1977777950.
Maria: update: 5xx down to 1.1%, p95 latency trending down but still ~1.2s above baseline for some paths. Team, we should keep mitigations until stable 30m.
Jessica: switching handoff to Samir in 6m. I'll collect impact notes for post-incident doc.
Samir: taking handoff. I'll keep watch on tool queue and re-enable features incrementally once stable.
Kevin: agree. Plan for rollback: 1) re-enable vector-search for enterprise only 2) relax per-tenant concurrency after 30m stable 3) revert plaintext fallback once p95 within 200ms of baseline. Documenting runbook entries I used in #runbooks.
Tia: CS asks if we can whitelist ledger-app for higher burst cap while they throttle clients — is that safe?
Samir: not right now, ledger-app is the cause of spike. Whitelisting would risk regression. Recommend they apply client-side backoff first.
Customer Support: told ledger-app to reduce client concurrency; they're doing a coordinated ramp-down.
Maria: telemetry at +18m: throughput normalized, error-rate ~0.4%, latency still 350ms above baseline on paths that required external calls.
Kevin: I'm leaving the soft-lock in place for non-enterprise for another 10m then will promote to relax if stable. Samir owns final sign-off.
Samir: final note: postmortem action items: - add graceful degradation for vector-search failures - expose per-route tool concurrency knobs in Console - add automated rollback if error-rate doesn't improve within 5m of mitigation.
Maria: thanks everyone. logging change set and filing incident with severity S2. We'll meet for a 30m postmortem and follow up with customers. :white_check_mark:
Kevin: handing off monitoring to Jessica for the next 2h. If anything flares, call paging chain.
IncidentBot: Incident closed to active mitigation at 1977778120; follow-up tasks created: #INC-1977777777.
